about: Every message between Kvad for iPhone's SwiftUI and its Rust core (core/src/session.rs, core/src/probe.rs), one example each, with every field it may have. Each is a JSON object with one key, its name. The core's tests send every command and check every event it emits against these; the Swift tests decode every event. docs/phone-swiftui-plan.md.
